target_narrative: For asset allocation with limited and noisy financial data, using evidence available by 2023-11-01 and comparing simpler ML with deeper neural networks on overfitting, data requirements, and out-of-sample risk-adjusted performance, conclude that simpler ML is more robust unless deep models demonstrate clear out-of-sample gains.
question_direction: Compare model roles and robustness, and consider combinations of risk measurement, return prediction, and asset allocation.
